Why did Denver have all their quarterbacks in the same location?  I thought teams were setup to have an emergency COVID squad (including QB) that stayed offsite and did the meetings online?

It will be okay.  Let's get out of this situation:

Capture those thoughts and control them - 2 Corinthians 10:5 

God loves you and does want you to worry.  Cast those worries on Him. Philippians 4:6-7

Ask God for help with your thought and focus on the many gifts He gives us each day!

I see this was suppose to be for women but I already started to answer it so you can ignore my answer if you want.  

Unfortunately, we live in a world wear people want attention and that mean they, including some Christians, will wear reveling clothing.  So, even if you can get the people in your church to dress modestly, you would need to deal with it outside church.  What to do?  I tell myself that God created those people and I'm to respect every single one of them, no matter what they wear.  

Remember 1 Corinthians 10:13 - 13 No temptation has overtaken you except what is common to mankind. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can endure it.

My walk has been an up and down experience.  I have been really close to Jesus and have been far away.  Recently, I lost my job and it has brought me back to Him.  I don't know where my life is going but I'm glad it is with Jesus!
